card.name: Partway through long words, before a rare ending
card.fires_on: Marks a word piece in the middle of a longer word that is still unfinished, such as ac- in acoustical or acromegaly, ast- in status asthmaticus, or hep- in hepatic. It also fires on odd spots in Spanish text and in split compounds.

modes.label: Split medical or technical words
modes.description: The marked piece sits inside a long medical or technical word that continues after it.
modes.example: status<< ast>>hmaticus. Patients should be advised

modes.label: Spanish words and phrases
modes.description: The marked piece is part of a Spanish word or short function word in running legal prose.

modes.label: Punctuation or slash in a term
modes.description: The marked piece is an opening bracket or slash inside a clinical term.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens that begin with "ent", so it steers the model away from continuing with an "ent" piece.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long, split-up word and pushes the model away from continuing with "ent".
